Snatch is not in the pool.

long_game_mechanics.gap: A doubles battle reaching turn 1001 is played on where the reference ties: a silent divergence, against the rule that unsupported cases fail explicitly. Fix: at turn > 1000 end the battle as a tie (TERMINAL, RESULT_TIE, the RESULT event), or refuse by name as singles does at 101. The warning lines need no state; the converter must accept them.

long_game_mechanics.mechanic: Endless Battle Clause (Champions OU only: Standard AG; Reg M-C's Flat Rules do not include it): from turn 101, when every active Pokemon of both sides is stale, one side externally, and no side can switch to a non-stale Pokemon, the side whose sheets carry a restorative berry and Harvest/Pickup/Recycle loses (else a tie)
long_game_mechanics.status: partial: singles refuses turn 101 by name; Reg M-C not affected
long_game_mechanics.pin: data/mods/champions/rulesets.ts:2-8 (Standard AG has the clause), config/formats.ts:288-299 (Reg M-C: Flat Rules, no clause), sim/battle.ts:1803-1903 (maybeTriggerEndlessBattleClause), :1763-1768 (staleness per side), sim/pokemon.ts:41-45 (RESTORATIVE_BERRIES), :1787-1797 (eat: pendingStaleness becomes staleness), :1868-1879 (setItem: Trick/Switcheroo by a foe external, any other internal), sim/battle.ts:1339-1340 (Skill Swap: volatileStaleness), data/moves.ts:4881 (Entrainment)
long_game_mechanics.evidence: test duoforge.state.singles (turn 100 refused, 99 accepted; decision 0083 section 6)
long_game_mechanics.gap: Staleness is set only by eating a restorative berry received through setItem (Trick, Switcheroo, Symbiosis; Recycle, Harvest, Pickup are gaps) or by Skill Swap / Entrainment from a foe. Modelling needs a staleness bit per member (internal/external), a volatile one per position and the pending one per item, plus the loser rule from the sheets (its `berry` flag is overwritten per Pokemon, not OR'ed: the pin's exact code). Cheaper and exact: keep refusing, but only when some Pokemon could be stale (then most singles games pass turn 100).
long_game_mechanics.batch: B7 (flow); singles only, after the certified singles kind
